mentions.name: Interactive history timeline
mentions.description: An interactive history timeline for exploring historical events, published on the author's personal site. It is an early attempt that the author is not yet satisfied with and finds difficult to build.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve always wanted an interactive history timeline, so I tried to create one [0], but I am not happy with the result. It’s difficult!
